title: Tiramisu Cookies
summary: These are super cute cookies to bake for any special occasion...
extendedSummary: These are super cute cookies to bake for any special occasion or just for yourself as they're tasty af. I fucking love coffee flavoured desserts as well, so this definitely does a lot for me.
method: Cream together melted butter and sugar until it is light and fluffy
Beat the egg into the mixture until well combined
Add flour, baking soda, baking powder (sift these), as well as salt and instant coffee, and then fold into the mixture.
Roll out little balls of cookies onto a baking tray lined with baking paper, and pop into the oven for 12-14 minutes
For icing: Whip the cream and mascarpone until light and fluffy, and then add the vanilla extract, and icing sugar until nice and uniform
Using a piping bag, pipe a nice gollap of the icing onto each cookie (once those are cooled), and dust with cocoa powder.
